dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Good timing. I have a job that needs doing, and you are the only one who can do it.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: ...Hehe, just wanted to see how you'd react.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you settling in okay?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Most definitely.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: I have seen furnishings like these plenty of times before, though I don't believe I've seen them arranged in this particular fashion.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: The layout is clearly inspired and thoroughly distinctive... Simply marvelous.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: In fact, I'm inclined to have the Yashiro Commission headquarters remodeled in this style.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Would you object to overseeing the project and making sure everything is to the right specifications?

choices.text: I feel like you're probably joking...?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Ah, what gave it away? My acting skills appear to have deteriorated.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: In any case, this place is refreshingly different.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: You may find me visiting you here quite often.

choices.text: Uh... I don't think that's a good idea.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Heh, why the pained expression?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Well, if it's really that much trouble, I won't force it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: If you wish to chat, then by all means, let's chat. What's on your mind?

choices.text: How's work in the Yashiro Commission?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: I had thought you'd be inquiring about more personal matters.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Heh, you don't need to worry about me being overworked.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Case in point — I still have the energy to chat with you here.

choices.text: But don't you find the work draining?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: People tend to find work draining if they haven't yet discovered what they are trying to protect.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: I, at least, don't have this problem.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, hats off to you.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: I am flattered beyond belief to receive your praise and concern for my well-being.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: But you needn't worry. At present, there is no one more suitable than I to be in the position of Yashiro Commissioner.

choices.text: But don't you think there's too much to do?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Oh, you mean my workload? Yes, it's rather enormous. But there's nothing that can be done about that.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: All I can do is try to work through each item as intelligently as possible.

choices.text: How's life in the Yashiro Commission?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Life? ...Once work is accounted for, precious little time remains to allocate to my personal life.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: If this is something that concerns you, I see a simple solution: you can be my valet.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: My diet and other day-to-day needs will be your responsibility.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Oh... as far as diet is concerned, I'm not a picky eater. And as for everything else... No, actually I don't think I have any peculiar habits that you need to be aware of.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Though if you ever discover anything that tastes new and different, bring some back for me too.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Hmm... yes, why not. Worth a try.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: ...Oh, you're actually being serious this time.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Indeed, I am.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: It's entirely up to you. Take your time and give it some thought. Consider it an ongoing discussion.

choices.text: For example, new kinds of milk tea?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Precisely. I'm looking forward to it already.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you want to do?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: #Have you ever taken a dog for a walk, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Taken a dog for a walk?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Yes. Where you stroll together with a canine companion.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Dogs are instinctually loyal. But no matter how well-behaved a dog might be, it gets unhappy if it's cooped up in the same place for too long.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Bringing it outdoors and watching it run free and enjoy itself is a splendid way to relax. It puts you in a good mood.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Don't you want to try?

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Don't worry. My staff will be sure to pick out a sufficiently docile dog for you.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Failing that... There's always Taroumaru.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Alright, I guess I can give it a try.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Alright then. If you have any reservations starting out, we can treat this as a practice area.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Once you've reached the point where you're able to enjoy it, we can head out onto the streets.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Drinking some milk tea and walking the dogs... I wouldn't be surprised if it causes some commotion.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Heh, not that I mind, of course.

response.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
response.text: Heh, raring to go, I see.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Ayato.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Shall we have breakfast together? I'll have my staff prepare something.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodnight, Ayato.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: #Good night, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Relax and sleep well. Nobody would dare disturb you.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Ah... this reminds me of when Ayaka was young, and we would visit the festival together...

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: It's immaculate. Even I, as Yashiro Commissioner, cannot find any fault with the way you have designed this place.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Since it's just the two of us here... shall we take a stroll together?

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: This is a truly exceptional design. The architectural style borrows from the Tri-Commission mansions, and the general arrangement is very aesthetically pleasing.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: The familiar environment makes me feel right at home, and good company only adds to the exquisiteness of the occasion.

dialogues.speaker: Kamisato Ayato
dialogues.text: Hmm, truly delightful.
